Causative-passiveSentences
"Causative-passive"sentences are the passive version of causative sentences.You can use causative-
passive sentences when you want to say that you were made to do, or harassed or talked into do-
ing, something that you did not want to.
（手歌の）歌歌。
(I didn't want to sing because I'm not a good singer, but) I was forced to sing.
（食）野食。
(I don't want to eat vegetables because I don't like them, but) I am (always) made to eat
vegetables.
